n1.speaker: npc_grist
n1.text: Clerk. One of yours is having a go at my stair. Watch this; it's the only part of the job I'm good at.

n2.speaker: npc_grist
n2.text: Not this way, love. Back to the hall, follow the candles. Nobody's forgotten you, it's just slow.

n3.speaker: narrator
n3.text: The soul looks at the stair, then at Grist, and drifts back toward the Arrival Hall.
